notes: I built a first rough model: a flat region near zero (|x|<20 gives ≈ -20.45, matching the two near-zero points in E1) and a quadratic growth for larger |x|. The large-|x| values are noisy and non-monotonic (e.g. f(93.6) < f(88.9)), so the quadratic is only a placeholder marked uncertain; more probes are needed to pin down the true shape.
